summary: Backend-only verification of manual_trade partial_close guard fix. Ran existing E2E (test_partial_exit_e2e.py, 6 tests) and new guard/HTTP-semantics tests (test_guard_external_adopted.py, 2 tests). All 8/8 PASSED. Confirmed: (a) website-manual paper trades (source='manuell') can execute 2x partial_close returning HTTP 200 with events 'TEIL-EXIT Stufe 1/2 (TP-Staffel|Teil-Absicherung)' and qty_remaining reduced; (b) external_adopted=True trades return HTTP 409 with detail mentioning 'extern/bitunix' (NOT 502, NOT 200); (c) nonexistent trade_id returns HTTP 404. Prior 502-bug regression fixed and holds.
critical_code_review_comments: Anti-Stacking-Detection nutzt anscheinend opened_at auch für geschlossene Trades im 30-Min-Fenster, was Retries des E2E-Tests ohne Cleanup blockiert. Kein Bug, aber Test-Setup-Fußangel (mitigiert durch cleanup vor Reruns).
routers/autotrade.py:397 nutzt Substring-Match auf 'nicht gefunden' zur 404-Ableitung. Robuster wäre ein dediziertes status='not_found' vom trade_manager.
seed_data_creation: test_guard_external_adopted inserts and removes a synthetic auto_trades doc (id=TEST_EXTERNAL_<uuid>, external_adopted=True). Verified 0 leftovers post-run. E2E-Trade wurde per POST /api/autotrade/close geschlossen.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guard-Fix (manual_trade blocked→allowed for source=manual, external_adopted still blocked for all sources) plus HTTP 409/400/404-Semantik in routers/autotrade.py:397-403 sind verifiziert. Vor Neuausführung von test_partial_exit_e2e.py ggf. offene BTCUSDT paper manual trades bereinigen (Anti-Stacking-Fenster 30 Min).
